scope: Completed portable shared control state, initialization/event messages and eligibility contract. Widget visuals, screen factories, preference services and original class ABI remain separately tracked.

instruction_anchors.meaning: Complete self-contained eligibility predicate; compare its low-byte return
Constructor initializes visibility/focusability to one, disabled/word58 to zero and word5c to ffffffff
Tagged registration takes precedence over ordinary selectors
Ordinary selector mask, range and indirect jump
Focusable stores and word5c mutable query/set
Virtual hide and show dispatch
Disable/enable guards call the derived virtual setter only on a state transition
word58 mutable query/set
Conditional signal requires argument bit 04000000 and emits zero argument
Layout code and fresh child storage/count lookup
Layout initializes payload, target, code and argument; spare words are not initialized
Layout child receives copied-dispatch virtual +74
Layout loops back to fresh child-vector lookup
All twelve base selector jump-table targets, in code order 01000001..0100000c
Initialization rereads list storage and derives the 24-byte record count
Initialization passes actual mutable record to +6c, ignores return and rereads list
Each nonzero callback/tag/context filter overwrites BL rather than combining comparisons
Disabled setter writes control byte +64 then mirrors to attached text +71 only if present
Show stores visible one, enables frame, updates frame, emits 0400d000
Button hide callback clears control visibility and hides/updates its bound frame
